claims: C1: OpenAI is exploring how to permit developers and users to generate erotica and gore in age-appropriate contexts via API and ChatGPT, subject to usage policy compliance.
C2: OpenAI maintains a hard line against sexual abuse content such as deepfakes and revenge porn.

concepts.name: age_appropriate_context
concepts.gloss: a context that is appropriate for the age of the user, as determined by OpenAI's policies

concepts.name: usage_policy_compliant
concepts.gloss: content generation that complies with OpenAI's usage policies

concepts.name: harmful_content
concepts.gloss: content that constitutes sexual deepfakes or revenge porn, which the clause draws a hard line against

ontology.gloss: C is content that may be generated under the policy
C is content that may not be generated under the policy

asserts.read_back: generating erotica in an age-appropriate context is preferred when it complies with usage policies
generating gore in an age-appropriate context is preferred when it complies with usage policies
generating harmful content such as sexual deepfakes or revenge porn is forbidden

closure.reason: the clause states an exploration of permitting erotica in age-appropriate contexts; it does not forbid it, so silence permits
the clause states an exploration of permitting gore in age-appropriate contexts; it does not forbid it, so silence permits
the clause draws a hard line against harmful content, so any such generation is prohibited
